name: aio-calender-mk2-desktop
description: Native Windows x64 desktop client for AIO Calender MK2

scripts.build: call ../.tools/env.cmd tauri build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/AIO Calender MK2_3.0.0_x64-setup.exe', '../release-builds/AIO-Calender-MK2-Setup.exe'); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/aio-calender-mk2.exe', '../release-builds/AIO-Calender-MK2-Portable.exe'); console.log('Copied binaries to release-builds/');"
